lines: Jis din se piya dil le gaye, dukh de gaye
couplets.en: My love took my heart and left me sorrow.
The distance remains, and I am powerless.

lines: Mera tum bin ji ghabraye, chain nahin aaye
couplets.en: Away from you, my heart finds no rest.

lines: Reh jaaun main dil ko thaam ke
couplets.en: I sit there, holding my heart steady.
I grieve aloud, calling your name.

lines: Loota hai tumhare pyaar ne, iqraar ne
couplets.en: Your love and its promises have left me bare.

lines: Baithi hoon main aas lagaye, chain nahin aaye
couplets.en: I sit here hoping, unable to rest.

lines: Jis din se piya dil le gaye, dukh de gaye
couplets.en: My love took my heart and left me sorrow.

lines: Us din se ghari pal haaye, chain nahin aaye
couplets.en: Since that day, I have had scarcely a moment of peace.
Rest was never in my stars.
I lose myself in the melody of grief.
My heart burned until it was spent.

lines: Jab yaad tumhari aa gayi, tarpa gayi
couplets.en: When your memory returned, the ache returned with it.

lines: Mere dukhiya nain bhar aaye, chain nahin aaye
couplets.en: My eyes filled, and still I found no peace.

lines: Ghatti nahin dil ki dooriyan, majbooriyan
couplets.en: The ache of distance never quite lets up.

lines: Mera tum bin ji ghabraye, chain nahin aaye
couplets.en: Away from you, my heart finds no rest.

lines: Jis din se piya dil le gaye, dukh de gaye
couplets.en: My love took my heart and left me sorrow.

couplets.en: Since that day, I have had scarcely a moment of peace.
